fit_circle_geometric — FIT fit op

• Data kinds: keypoints → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fit_circle_geometric(points, *, max_iterations: 'int' = 100, radius_limit_factor: 'float' = 1000000.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import measure; measure.fit_circle_geometric(points, *, max_iterations: 'int' = 100, radius_limit_factor: 'float' = 1000000.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsfit.get("fit_circle_geometric"))

Usage

Fit a circle and radius to (row, col) points, including short arcs, by geometric least squares.

Kåsa's algebraic fit supplies the initial centre and radius, then a Levenberg--Marquardt solve minimises hypot(x-cx, y-cy) - r (Chernov & Lesort 2005). Returns cy, cx, r, geometric rms, iterations and converged. max_iterations is the maximum number of function evaluations. radius_limit_factor bounds the fitted radius relative to the point-cloud span; an exceeded bound is reported as ValueError instead of returning a line-like, effectively infinite circle. Non-finite, collinear, or fewer than three points are also rejected.
